prose: The Financial Times reports that Google Threat Intelligence Group found dark web marketplaces selling access to AI models - including those from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI - at discounts of up to 97%. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Google Threat Intelligence: dark web markets sell access to frontier AI models
Anthropic, Google and OpenAI models among those offered
Discounts up to 97% off legitimate access
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
